title: Third-Party Quality Certification in the Market for Financial Advice
eligible_reason: Firm-level panel of small RIA firms (<=50 employees), 2009-2020. Treatment top1000_owner = 1 if the firm is owned by a Barron's Top-1000 advisor in year t; it switches on at firm-specific years (278 ever-treated firms; first-treatment years 2009-2020, 12 cohorts, 104 already treated in their first observed year; ~21,600 never-treated firms). Table 2 col 2 (F.log_aum) and Table 5 col 1 (F.misconduct) regress the t+1 outcome on top1000_owner with firm FE and state-by-year FE, no controls, linear, cluster by firm. Treatment switches off (152 switch-off events; 496 post-adoption rows with treatment 0) -> drop those rows per Hull fn. 6. Shipped data are real (Form ADV / Barron's built panel).
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. master_stata.do lines 70-91 (Table 2) and 211-221 (Table 5 cols 1-2): use final_firm_level_sample; drop if number_employee > 50; xtset fcrdn year; reghdfe f.log_aum top1000_owner, absorb(fcrdn year#grp_state) cluster(fcrdn). Outcome uses Stata's lead operator f. (missing when year t+1 is not observed; 2,655 gaps in the firm panel). Table 2 col 1 has no firm FE; col 3 adds l_top1000_owner (extra treatment regressor); col 4 and Table 5 col 2 are ppmlhdfe (Poisson). Advisor-level Tables 3, 4, 6, 7 use treat (Top-100 within Top-1000) or top100 with norm_ranking (continuous ranking score), time-varying license/tenure controls, and firm FE on top of advisor FE (advisors move across firms), and Table 4 is a state-cutoff RD-style design: not eligible. Figures 1-2 are PanelMatch matching event studies (R): not eligible. Table IA8 is a stacked cohort design (icrdn#cohort): not eligible. grp_state (firm HQ state) varies within firm for 1,433 of 21,865 firms (27 of 278 treated firms), so the state-by-year FE are not strictly a time-invariant characteristic x year; recommend fixing state at the firm's first (or modal) state for CSA/BJS and recording the deviation, or using the observed state as published for TWFE.

specs.outcome: F.log_aum (log firm AUM in year t+1; construct as lead of log_aum within fcrdn under xtset fcrdn year, missing if t+1 not observed)
specs.notes: Treatment switches off; drop post-adoption rows with top1000_owner == 0. grp_state varies within 1,433 firms; fix at first observed state for modern estimators (deviation). Approximate N ~97,500 with ~930 treated rows.

specs.outcome: F.misconduct (indicator for >=1 firm misconduct event in year t+1; lead of misconduct within fcrdn)
specs.notes: Linear probability model. Same treatment-switch-off and state caveats as T2c2. Approximate N ~100,000.

appendix_only_specs.reported_location: Internet Appendix Table IA.2 Panel A, column 2

data_files_note: README states the package contains all data needed; final firm panel has 143,539 firm-years (127,229 after the <=50-employee restriction), with plausible AUM values.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text, no PDF, empty OpenAlex abstract in candidates.csv; abstract taken from data/frame/mnsc.jsonl). Table numbers come from the eststo names and esttab output file names in master_stata.do. Main-text status of Tables 2 and 5 inferred from README (Table1-Table7 = main paper). Confirm against the article when available.
